newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bank of Japan to launch homepage on the Internet.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Japan to launch homepage on the Internet.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) said it will launch a homepage on the Internet on Friday offering real-time information about its monetary policies and economic indicators.

The central bank said the page would provide information on monetary policies, such as changes in its official discount rate, and economic indicators like money supply, the wholesale price index, and its closely watched "tankan" short-term survey of corporate sentiment.
The BOJ said it would also provide a database containing economic indicators over the past 20 years.
Other information, such as speeches by the BOJ governor and economic reports like the central bank's quarterly economic outlook, would also be made available via the Internet, a BOJ statement said.
The central bank's homepage, http://www.boj.go.jp, will be available in both Japanese and English.
